description: This file is a shell script that sets up tests and verifies the behavior of the 'git show' command under various scenarios. It contains test setup, execution, and assertions for different use cases involving git object display, ranges, tags, trees, and merges.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure with a given command.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit, possibly in a specified directory or with parameters.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Merges branches or commits as part of the test setup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases.
